prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE production reference sheet for the Toktogi 2D game. Match the already displayed C011 springtail reference in rounded low-poly cartoon forms, clean dark blue-gray edge definition, restrained surface texture, readable four-tone shading, matte natural green/brown palette (the plant must retain its natural color, not springtail white). Off-white background, uniform neutral light, orthographic multi-view panels: top, front, left, right, back, underside/detail, consistently same object, no perspective distortion, no scenery, no shadow crossing panels, no text on object. Labels outside object in English with asset ID. Broad simple forms suitable for editable low-poly Blender geometry. Do not add a springtail character. This is a reference sheet, not a runtime sprite. Subject: B0A A thin attached periphyton biofilm layer: irregular pale olive-green to brown translucent organic patch, subtle sparse dot colonies, gently ragged lobed boundary, flat coating adhering to a substrate. Show top, edge thickness, underside and detail on neutral demonstration surface. Do not make moss, grass, tentacles or independent animals. Microbe composition and physical size UNKNOWN; no food claim.
style_input_delivery: Reference displayed in conversation; new-image call omitted explicit image-path arguments.
correction: 생성 시트의 불투명 바탕은 제작 배경이다. 실제 출력은 부착층만 반투명하게 저장한다. 군집 점은 종 식별 구조가 아니다.
selection_reason: 생물 명세의 큰 형태와 프로젝트 카툰 톤 참고. 실제 정투영·기관 수는 제작 계약과 Blender 출력이 우선한다.
